mapper.sql: id, user_id, record_date, exercise_type, duration, distance, calories_burned, remark, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exercise_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{recordDate} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM exercise_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY record_date DESC
SELECT FROM exercise_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exercise_record (id, user_id, record_date, exercise_type, duration, distance, calories_burned, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{recordDate}, #{exerciseType}, #{duration}, #{distance}, #{caloriesBurned}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE exercise_record SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
